items.name: Slow
items.text: A risen ydrei is permanently Slowed 1 and can't use reactions.

items.name: Baleful Bite
items.text:
Requirements The risen ydrei has a creature Grabbed or Restrained

---
Effect The risen ydrei makes a fangs Strike against the grabbed creature. If the Strike hits and inflicts damage, the creature is exposed to necrotic venom.

items.name: Impenetrable Scales
items.text:
Frequency once per minute

Requirements The risen ydrei has taken physical damage since the end of its last turn

---
Effect The risen ydrei's immortal essence infuses its scales, making it virtually impervious to further blows. Until the start of its next turn, the risen ydrei gains resistance 20 to physical damage.

items.name: Necrotic Venom
items.text:
Saving Throw DC 37 Fortitude save

Maximum Duration 6 rounds

Stage 1 Enfeebled 1 and regains 10 fewer Hit Points from all sources of healing (1 round)

Stage 2 enfeebled 1 and regains 20 fewer Hit Points from all sources of healing (1 round)

items.name: Slithering Surge
items.text:
Frequency once per minute

Requirements The risen ydrei's previous action was a successful Strike, and it doesn't have a creature Grabbed

---
Effect The risen ydrei is empowered by its immortal essence to momentarily transcend the limitations of its undead form, darting across the battlefield in a murderous blur. It immediately Strides up to 25 feet and makes another attack of the same type against a different creature. This Strike uses the same multiple attack penalty as the previous one, but it counts toward the risen ydrei's multiple attack penalty as usual.
